hypothesis: The scored truth is by construction the set of faults absent from the competition catalogue. The USGS State Geologic Map Compilation is an independently compiled product, so a state-map fault that lies more than one kernel width (300 m) from every catalogue cell is a high-precision candidate for an expert-labelled 'new' fault.
mechanism: Source-provenance complement, then geometry. (1) Exclude the catalogue with a 300 m buffer, because a prediction near a catalogued fault earns no credit while still paying the linear mass tax 0.2*N; this completes an empirically validated 200 m prune that public leaderboard evidence shows was worth +0.0178. (2) Gate on trace shape using the principal-axis eigenvalue ratio lambda_1/lambda_2 >= 6 and a principal extent >= 5 cells -- orientation invariant, where the two obvious alternatives (bounding-box fill fraction, bounding-box aspect ratio) are not. (3) Emit one dot per 200 m along the surviving traces, because TP_w is a per-truth-cell MAXIMUM, so redundancy costs 0.2 per dot and earns nothing.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: State geologic map compilation line work that is not a Quaternary fault: (a) pre-Quaternary (Tertiary) faults with no surface scarp, which appear on state maps but are not in the experts' label set; (b) non-fault linework -- dike and vein traces, lithologic contacts digitised as lines, and map neatlines; (c) mylonitic or metamorphic fabric boundaries. The linearity gate removes (b) and (c) only to the extent that they are blob-shaped or short; item (a) is NOT removed by anything in this design and is the main reason the artefact could underperform. A Quaternary viability gate was specified as the direct remedy (hypothesis H54-B) but was not run in this session.

holdout_dti.reason_not_reported_as_a_score: Not established, and deliberately left null. The only available proxy builds its truth from the same USGS SGMC raster this artefact is built from, so the feature-alone leakage canary returns AUC = 0.998 by construction (uniform-control probe 0.500).

detection_floor.verdict: A 0.0028 DTI gap needs 296,457 informative withheld truth cells at distinct-architecture noise; the holdout supplies 12,429, short by 24x. The gap is inside the detection floor.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.note: For those three rasters a node lies within 300 m of essentially every study-area cell (r13 covers 0.999 of the footprint), so the 3 px overlap statistic is satisfied by any prediction set and is excluded from the verdict; only rank-correlation and reverse overlap are informative against them.

checks.all_cells_finite: OK non_finite=0 -- no NaN anywhere, inside the footprint or outside it

verdict_rationale: Format is portal-legal (9/9 checks) and the artefact is in a distinct lane (max |rho| = 0.004 vs a 0.90 limit), so uploading it is safe and it will be scored. It is NOT validated: it has no trustworthy holdout DTI, because the only holdout available cannot rank submissions and is circular against this artefact. It carries 58% less mass than the 0.2778 incumbent family. Its bet is stated so it can be checked: it beats 0.2778 if at least about 12% of its 15,907 dots fall within the 300 m kernel of a hidden expert fault cell, against an incumbent implied hit rate of about 13%.

experiments: E1 exact-metric verification and byte forensics on six leaderboard-linked artefacts
E2 mass-calibrated proxy re-ranking (failed to repair the ordering)
E3 metric-optimal thinning of an incumbent dot set (NEGATIVE: 23.5% of dots removed, 10.0% of credit lost, proxy DTI fell)
budget_used.note: Budget exhausted at 3 experiments per the protocol, so the submission was built from verified algebra and the unblocked reasoning above rather than from a fourth validation experiment.

negative_results_companion: Metric-optimal thinning of an existing emission loses credit, so 'one dot per kernel width' is not a free mass saving on a pre-existing cloud (it is the right rule only when emitting from scratch).
Mass-calibrating the proxy to the leaderboard-implied truth size does not repair its ranking.
The mirrored 'sample_submission.tif' sold to the corpus as the all-zero format template is cell-for-cell the catalogue mask.

holdout_screening.what_it_can_answer: Whether a candidate's dots land on real, independently mapped faults that the competition catalogue does not contain.
holdout_screening.what_it_cannot_answer: Whether that skill transfers to the organisers' hidden expert labels. This holdout does not order submissions: Spearman rho = -0.029 (p = 0.957) against the public leaderboard across the 6 artefacts that have both bytes and a published score.

this_artefact.label: PROXY-DTI (CIRCULAR for this artefact - NOT a score)
this_artefact.circular_because: The dots are placed on the SGMC raster and this holdout's truth is built from that same raster, so the score measures self-consistency. The single-feature leakage canary agrees: SGMC alone scores AUC = 0.998 against this truth, against a 0.90 cut.

holdout_screening.ci95_note: No confidence interval is published for this artefact because no valid holdout exists for it. A bootstrap over truth segments would be the wrong null here: resampled segments keep their real geometry, so the interval collapses and flatters the candidate.
